title: GCC banks raise $3.6bln in Q2
summary: The total marks the lowest quarterly volume in two years
thbAction: Map the news to THB's provider CRM for referral growth, patient lifecycle engagement, and multi-facility relationship management across hospital and provider networks.
contentHtml:
The total marks the lowest quarterly volume in two years

Staff Writer ,  ZAWYA

Banks in the GCC raised $3.58 billion through debt and equity issuances, excluding sukuk, in the second quarter, as easing geopolitical tensions encouraged lenders to return to capital markets.
